frames.name: 议论型：现象—原因—对策
frames.desc: 六级最常见题型。段一描述现象并点明观点，段二给两个原因，段三给一两条对策或展望。

parts.label: 第一段（描述+立场）
parts.text: In recent years, ______ has become increasingly common among ______. While some regard it as ______, I would argue that ______.
parts.note: 开头 2 句内必须出现"我的立场"，否则阅卷老师找不到观点。

parts.label: 第二段（原因 1）
parts.text: The first reason is practical. ______, which means that ______.
parts.note: 原因要具体到"因为……所以……"，不要空喊 important。

parts.label: 第二段（原因 2）
parts.text: A second factor is less obvious: ______.
parts.note: less obvious 能体现思维层次，是加分表达。

parts.label: 第三段（对策）
parts.text: To address this, ______ should ______. Individuals, too, can ______.
parts.note: 对策要落到具体主体：政府/学校/企业/个人。

parts.label: 收尾
parts.note: 倒装句收尾，句式分稳拿。

frames.name: 观点对比型
frames.desc: 题目给两种看法，让你说明自己的选择。关键是"承认对方合理，再给出更强理由"。

parts.label: 第一段
parts.text: Opinions differ on whether ______. Some insist that ______, while others maintain that ______.
parts.note: 用 insist / maintain 替换 say，词汇分立刻上去。

parts.label: 第二段（让步）
parts.text: There is some truth in the first view: ______.

parts.label: 第二段（转折立论）
parts.text: Nevertheless, I side with the second group, mainly because ______.
parts.note: Nevertheless 后是全文最重要的一句。

parts.label: 第三段
parts.text: A balanced approach may be the most realistic: ______.
parts.note: 结尾给折中方案，比单纯站队更成熟。

frames.name: 图表 / 书信型
frames.desc: 图表题先描述趋势再解释；书信题注意称呼、目的句和礼貌收尾。

parts.label: 图表开头
parts.text: The chart shows that the number of ______ rose steadily from ______ to ______, while ______ declined.
parts.note: rose steadily / declined / remained stable 三个动词够用。

parts.label: 图表解释
parts.text: Two factors may account for this trend. First, ______. Second, ______.
parts.note: account for = 解释，比 explain 更书面。

parts.label: 书信开头
parts.note: 目的句必须一句话说清写信原因。

parts.label: 书信结尾
parts.text: I would appreciate it if you could ______ at your earliest convenience.
parts.note: I would appreciate it if 是万能礼貌句。

patterns.slot: 换掉"It is well known that"，避免烂大街

patterns.en: There is a growing awareness that ______.
What concerns me most is not ______ but ______.
This trend can be attributed to two factors.
patterns.cn: 这一趋势可归因于两个因素
patterns.slot: 比 there are two reasons 高级
例子要一句话说完，不要展开太长
没数据时可写 recent surveys

patterns.en: This is not to say that ______; rather, ______.
On the one hand, ______; on the other hand, ______.
patterns.slot: 注意 on the other hand 不加 the 也可

patterns.en: Those who oppose it argue that ______.

patterns.slot: 语法分点，风险也高，确保写对

patterns.en: It is high time that we ______.

patterns.slot: 倒装必须完整，别漏 can
root cause 比 reason 深
后面加具体内容才不空

patterns.en: It is the responsibility of ______ to ______.
A small change in ______ can make a difference.
As far as I am concerned, ______.
The evidence so far points to ______.

items.en: pass down from generation to generation

samples.title: 范文 · 大学生该不该兼职

body.para: In recent years, part-time work has become increasingly common among university students. While some regard it as a distraction from study, I would argue that a well-managed part-time job teaches lessons the classroom cannot.
body.note: 开头两句完成"现象+立场"，没有一句废话。

body.para: The first reason is practical. A student who works ten hours a week must plan the remaining time carefully, which means that procrastination becomes expensive. This is not a small gain: time management is the skill employers mention most often when they complain about graduates.
body.note: 原因具体到"因为要规划时间，所以拖延成本变高"，并顺势连到雇主视角。

body.para: A second factor is less obvious. Work exposes students to people who do not share their background, and dealing with a difficult customer is a more effective lesson in patience than any lecture on the subject.
body.note: less obvious 提示层次，例子落到"难缠的顾客"，可感。

body.para: To make this work, universities should limit weekly hours to around ten and offer advice on choosing jobs related to one’s field. Individuals, too, can keep a simple record of hours and grades; if one falls while the other rises, the balance has failed.
body.note: 对策分主体：学校给上限与指导，个人给可操作的自查方法。

body.para: Only in this way can part-time work serve education rather than compete with it.

highlights: While some regard it as…, I would argue that…
A second factor is less obvious.

samples.title: 范文 · 短视频与注意力

body.para: Opinions differ on whether short videos enrich or damage the way we think. Some insist that they make knowledge accessible to everyone; others maintain that they train us to expect constant stimulation. I side with the second group, though not for the reason usually given.
body.note: 观点对比型开头，"though not for the reason usually given"制造悬念。

body.para: There is some truth in the first view. A two-minute explanation of photosynthesis can reach a student who would never open a textbook. Access matters, and it is snobbery to pretend otherwise.
body.note: 先让步，承认对方合理，避免一边倒。

body.para: Nevertheless, the problem is not the length of a video but what it trains. A medium that rewards the first three seconds teaches creators to begin with surprise and to abandon explanation. Viewers are not made stupid; they are made impatient, which is worse, because impatience feels like a personal trait rather than a habit that can be changed.
body.note: 把"内容问题"重新定义为"训练问题"，是本文的思维增量。

body.para: The remedy is unglamorous. Watch one long video a week and write three sentences about it afterwards. The writing is the point: it converts passive watching into retrieval, and retrieval is what makes knowledge stay.
body.note: 对策具体到"每周一个长视频+三句话"，可执行。

body.para: In the long run, attention is less like a resource to be spent than a muscle to be trained.
body.note: 比喻收尾，比 "we should use phones less" 高一个层次。

highlights: it is snobbery to pretend otherwise

samples.title: 范文 · 城市绿地该不该优先

body.para: The chart shows that spending on urban parks in the province rose steadily from 2018 to 2025, while spending on new roads declined slightly. Two factors may account for this trend.
body.note: 图表型开头：一句描述趋势，一句点出原因段。

body.para: The first is a change in how cities count benefits. A road produces measurable traffic; a park produces cleaner air, lower summer temperatures and better mental health, none of which appear on a balance sheet. As the cost of extreme heat has become visible in hospital admissions, the invisible benefits of shade have started to be counted.
body.note: 把"不可测量"讲清楚，是图表解释的高分写法。

body.para: The second factor is political. Parks are local, visible and quick to deliver, which matters to officials judged between elections. A motorway takes a decade; a park takes a summer.
body.note: 政治与任期视角，超出一般考生。

body.para: None of this means roads are unnecessary. It means that the choice between grey and green is rarely made on equal terms, because one benefit can be invoiced and the other cannot. Requiring every new road project to publish its heat and health effects would make the comparison fairer.
body.note: 不否定对方，提出制度性改进，结尾有落点。

highlights: Two factors may account for this trend.
none of which appear on a balance sheet

samples.title: 范文 · 给图书馆的建议信

body.para: Dear Director, I am writing to suggest a small change to the opening hours of the university library.
body.note: 书信目的句，一句话说清。

body.para: During the examination period, the reading rooms close at ten, while the dormitories are too noisy for serious work after that hour. Many students therefore study in corridors, which is neither comfortable nor safe.
body.note: 问题+后果，两部分都具体。

body.para: I would suggest extending the closing time to midnight for the four weeks before examinations, and keeping only the second floor open so that staffing costs remain modest. A trial period of one semester would show whether the demand is as large as students believe.
body.note: 建议包含成本考虑与试行方案，显得成熟。

body.para: I would appreciate it if you could consider this proposal at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your time.
body.note: 礼貌结尾，句式固定好用。

highlights: so that staffing costs remain modest
I would appreciate it if you could…

items: 开头两句话内表明了自己的立场
每个主体段都有一个明确的中心句
没有跑题到题目之外的话题
字数达到 150 词以上（六级要求 150-200）
三段式清晰：引入 / 论证 / 结论
段与段之间有过渡词（first / besides / nevertheless）
结论段没有引入新论点
没有把两个论点混在同一段
全文时态统一（议论一般用现在时）
主谓一致、单复数没有明显错误
没有连续两句用同一个主语开头
没有中文式表达（如 very important to our society 的空话）
至少用了 3 个高分句式（倒装 / 让步 / 虚拟 / not…but…）
至少用了 5 个主题词块，而不是 important / good / bad
有 1-2 个具体例子或数据，不是纯说理
结尾没有用 "In a word" 这类模板词
